assessment.nobel_worthiness: A poetic oeuvre of long duration that reworks the Arabic poetic idiom through myth, fragmentation and sustained argument with inherited forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses are the works the longlist names. Formal and linguistic achievement is high, and the work is distinctive and intellectually deep, with essays that reinforce the poetic project.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer citation is straightforward. It would rest on the renewal of Arabic poetic language and on the poetry and essays as one body of work, not on any one volume.
assessment.maturity: Decades of sustained work, with a reception that is well developed and influential within Arabic literature. The oeuvre is complete enough to be judged as a whole.
uncertainties: Poetry that depends on Arabic prosody and diction is hard to judge in translation, and I cannot independently verify translation quality.
My knowledge of the full corpus beyond the named works is partial.
Weight given to the essays versus the poetry in a citation is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike, non-psychological fiction that destabilizes space, causality and character. Very distinctive in voice and formally uncompromising, and it makes unusual demands on the reader. Frontier and Love in the New Millennium are the named works. Imaginative depth is considerable and the project has been sustained over a long career.
assessment.attribution: Clear single authorship with a recognizable method. A citation would center on fiction that reinvents narrative logic and on its place in Chinese-language literature.
assessment.maturity: A long, consistent body of work. The oeuvre appears to have deepened without losing its strangeness, though I cannot confirm sustained quality across every volume.
uncertainties: Reading is mostly through translation, and the effect of translation on the prose texture is uncertain.
Critical consensus on which works are strongest is less settled than for some other candidates.
Whether the oeuvre has the range the will's wording implies, or is one strong method repeated, needs closer testing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose that turns memory and the body into a metaphysical project, across fiction and poetry. Blinding and Solenoid show ambition, scale and a strongly individual voice. Imaginative and intellectual depth are high.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation would reasonably cover the large-scale prose cosmology, with the poetry as context.
assessment.maturity: A substantial body of work with a long-running central project. The later volumes are large and ambitious, and the durability of the whole remains to be tested.
uncertainties: The density and length of the major works make translation quality and reader access significant concerns.
I have limited ability to compare the Romanian originals with translations.
Whether the scale is always matched by sustained quality across the volumes is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic novels that remake the form through Indigenous sovereignty, oral structures and ecological time. Carpentaria and The Swan Book show original formal ambition and a voice that is not derivative of European models. Significance across the body of work is considerable even though the fiction list is short.
assessment.attribution: Clear single authorship. A citation could focus on the reinvention of the novel from Aboriginal Australian perspectives, with nonfiction as supporting context.
assessment.maturity: A smaller number of major novels than most other candidates. Their depth is high, but the oeuvre is still developing.
uncertainties: The number of major fiction works is limited, and 'sustained quality' is harder to establish than for longer careers.
Cultural and linguistic specificity may affect how the work is read outside its context.
I cannot independently verify the reception of the nonfiction.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid works that remake the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red and Nox are inventive and formally unusual. The voice is distinct and the intellectual range is wide.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation would stress formal innovation across poetry, essay and translation-inflected work.
assessment.maturity: A long and varied career with consistent invention. Its durability against the inventive-but-niche risk remains to be judged.
uncertainties: Some of the work depends on classical knowledge, which may narrow its general significance.
The weighting of performance and book-object forms in an oeuvre assessment is uncertain.
Whether the oeuvre is a consistent literary architecture or a series of brilliant experiments is a judgment I hold only tentatively.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences and landscape-scale works that turn suffering and dictatorship-era memory into collective memorial form. Purgatory and Anteparadise are the named works. The achievement is distinctive and the ambition is clear, with strong ethical and formal stakes.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer citation is clear and would rest on the poetry and its extension into public, visual forms.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a consistent project. Extra-textual interventions complicate how the work is judged as literature.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation loses much, and my access to the Spanish texture is indirect.
How to weigh the non-textual, landscape-scale pieces as literature is uncertain.
The political and historical significance should not stand in for literary merit, and the two are hard to separate here.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed prose that transforms obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven show linguistic intensity and a highly distinctive style. Formal achievement is high.
assessment.attribution: Clear single authorship. A citation would center on the compressed prose and the fictional treatment of lives and art.
assessment.maturity: A relatively slim oeuvre, with great concentration of quality. Whether its range is broad enough for the full scope of the will is the main question.
uncertainties: The style is hard to carry across into translation, and I cannot judge how well it has been.
The limited volume of work makes breadth harder to assess.
My knowledge of the later works is partial.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative prose and moral interiority that bring theology, family and American history into dialogue. Housekeeping and Gilead show a distinctive, controlled voice and real imaginative and ethical depth. The prose is a strong formal achievement.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation would rest on the contemplative, theologically informed novels and essays.
assessment.maturity: A small number of novels over a long period, with a sustained essay practice. The novels are consistent in quality, but the fiction oeuvre is narrow in volume and range.
uncertainties: The narrowness of the fiction oeuvre in volume and range is a concern for the criterion of sustained, wide significance.
The theological framing may be read differently by different readers, and I should not treat it as inherently a merit.
I cannot independently verify the critical consensus on the later novels.
